name: Aeroflot
verdict: PJSC Aeroflot is majority state-owned: the Russian Federation is the controlling shareholder of approximately 73.8% of shares.
note: Rating note: Severe because the state owner is directly tied to an ongoing armed conflict. Russia planned to sell ~23.76% of its stake (Interfax, 2026), which would cut the state to ~50% but keep control. Sanctions context: https://www.consilium.europa.eu/en/policies/sanctions-against-russia-explained/.

why.text: The Russian state owns about 74% of Aeroflot. Russia has been at war with Ukraine since its full-scale invasion in February 2022, and after Western countries imposed sanctions over the invasion, Aeroflot stopped almost all its international flights. A famous shirt makes the country look good to millions of fans while that goes on. That’s called sportswashing.
why.messageLine: Russia is fighting the war in Ukraine, and Aeroflot has been under EU and US sanctions since 2022.

why.text: The Chinese state is Bank of Shanghai's largest shareholder through Shanghai SASAC-controlled Alliance Investment, holding 14.73% (14.98% with concert parties) with two nominated directors, though the bank reports no controlling shareholder. The UN human rights office found in 2022 that serious human rights violations had been committed against Uyghurs and other mostly Muslim communities in Xinjiang, including large-scale arbitrary detention that may amount to crimes against humanity.

why.text: Abu Dhabi’s state fund Mubadala is a shareholder in G42, and Mubadala’s chief executive sits on G42’s board, which is chaired by Abu Dhabi’s deputy ruler. In March 2025, the UAE’s Federal Supreme Court upheld the convictions of 53 people from a mass trial that Human Rights Watch called unfair. A famous team makes the country look good to millions of fans while that goes on. That’s called sportswashing.
why.messageLine: The UAE’s courts upheld the convictions from an unfair mass trial of activists and dissidents.

name: GAC
verdict: GAC (Guangzhou Automobile Group), a Chinese carmaker controlled by the Guangzhou municipal government.

why.text: GAC is controlled by the Guangzhou city government: its state-assets commission is GAC's actual controller, and holds 90% of Guangzhou Automobile Industry Group, which owns 54.02% of GAC. The UN human rights office found in 2022 that China committed serious human rights violations against Uyghurs and other mostly Muslim communities in Xinjiang, including large-scale arbitrary detention that may amount to crimes against humanity. So the money behind GAC is the Chinese state's.
why.messageLine: The UN human rights office found that China’s large-scale arbitrary detention of Uyghurs in Xinjiang may amount to crimes against humanity.

note: The link (claim gac-group-record): GAC Group's 2025 annual report (HKEX and cninfo editions) names Guangzhou Automobile Industry Group as controlling shareholder with 54.02% and the Guangzhou Municipal SASAC, a department of the Guangzhou Municipal People's Government, as actual controller with 90% of Guangzhou Automobile Industry Group; Nikkei Asia (28 Sep 2026) reports the Guangzhou city government controls about two-thirds of GAC. The chain is gac-group, guangzhou-municipal-government, government-of-china: the Chinese state controls GAC through its city government. The record (claim china-xinjiang-un-assessment): the UN OHCHR 2022 Xinjiang assessment and Human Rights Watch (2026). The tier is for a maintainer to set (METHOD.md 'Sponsor tiers': a state with a record that controls the sponsor). Not recorded as claims: Sheffield Hallam's Driving Force report (Oct 2024) lists GAC Group among companies in the Ürümqi Toutunhe automotive zone in the Uyghur Region but makes no forced-labour finding against GAC; Nikkei Asia (28 Sep 2026) reports an agreement of intent for FAW Group, controlled by China's central SASAC, to become GAC's second-largest shareholder.

ON HOLD: a proposed rating resting on state ownership with a documented record awaits a maintainer's review (same pattern as saic-motor).

why.text: The UN human rights office found in 2022 that serious human rights violations had been committed against Uyghurs and other mostly Muslim communities in Xinjiang, including large-scale arbitrary detention that may amount to crimes against humanity. Greentown, Zhejiang FC's naming and back-of-shirt sponsor, is the brand of Greentown China Holdings, whose single largest shareholder is the wholly state-owned China Communications Construction Group (CCCG) with approximately 28.88% of the company.
why.messageLine: Greentown: wholly state-owned CCCG is owner Greentown China's largest shareholder (~28.88%); the UN has documented serious abuses in Xinjiang.

verdict: Huayuan Securities, a Chinese brokerage controlled by the Wuhan municipal government through its state financial holding group. Front-of-shirt sponsor of Wuhan Three Towns (2026).

why.text: Huayuan Securities is controlled by the Wuhan city government: Wuhan Financial Holdings Group, which the city wholly owns as its only first-level state financial platform, holds 50% of Huayuan Securities and is its actual controller. The UN human rights office found in 2022 that China committed serious human rights violations against Uyghurs and other mostly Muslim communities in Xinjiang, including large-scale arbitrary detention that may amount to crimes against humanity. So the money behind Huayuan Securities is the Chinese state's.
why.messageLine: The UN human rights office found that China's large-scale arbitrary detention of Uyghurs in Xinjiang may amount to crimes against humanity.

note: The link (claim huayuan-securities-state-ownership): Huayuan Securities' shareholder page names Wuhan Financial Holdings (Group) as 50% holder and actual controller; the group's own profile says it is a wholly state-owned enterprise of Wuhan city; the chain is wuhan-financial-holdings, wuhan-municipal-government, government-of-china, so the Chinese state controls the sponsor through its city government. The record (claim china-xinjiang-un-assessment): the UN OHCHR 2022 Xinjiang assessment and Human Rights Watch (2026). The tier is for a maintainer to set (METHOD.md 'Sponsor tiers': a state with a record that controls the sponsor).

why.text: Jumeirah is a member of Dubai Holding, the global investment holding company owned by Dubai's ruler, Sheikh Mohammed bin Rashid Al Maktoum. A famous boat makes the country look good to millions of fans while that goes on. That's called sportswashing.

So the money behind Laoshan Beer is the Chinese state's.

why.text: MAN Truck & Bus is a company of the TRATON GROUP, and Volkswagen International Luxemburg S.A. — a Volkswagen Group company — holds 87.52% of TRATON SE's share capital. Qatar Holding LLC, the investment arm of Qatar's sovereign wealth fund, the Qatar Investment Authority, holds 10.4% of Volkswagen's subscribed capital and 17.0% of its voting rights, making it the third-largest shareholder. So the Qatari state's money is behind MAN. Amnesty International and Human Rights Watch both report that migrant workers in Qatar continued to face labour abuses under the kafala sponsorship system in 2025 despite reforms.
why.messageLine: Amnesty International reports that migrant workers in Qatar continued to face labour abuses, including an exploitative kafala sponsorship system, despite recent legal reforms.

note: Rating note: concern. The link: MAN Truck & Bus is a company of TRATON GROUP per MAN's own site (claim man-traton-vw-ownership); TRATON SE's 2025 annual report names Volkswagen International Luxemburg S.A. as its largest single shareholder with 87.52% (same claim, second source); Volkswagen AG's Annual Report 2025 shows Qatar Holding LLC with 10.4% of subscribed capital and 17.0% of voting rights (existing claim qatar-holding-vw-stake), with Qatar Holding LLC a wholly-owned QIA subsidiary and QIA the sovereign wealth fund of the State of Qatar (existing claims qatar-holding-qia-ownership, qia-government-of-qatar-ownership). why.text: MHP is a subsidiary of Porsche AG, which signed an agreement on 24 August 2026 to sell it to Tata Consultancy Services. Volkswagen AG indirectly holds 75.4% of Porsche AG’s share capital, and Qatar Holding LLC, a wholly owned subsidiary of the Qatar Investment Authority, the State of Qatar’s sovereign wealth fund, holds 10.4% of Volkswagen AG’s subscribed capital and 17.0% of its voting rights. verdict: Petronas is wholly state-owned - its shares sit with Minister of Finance (Incorporated), a body corporate created by statute - and Malaysia's record (migrant….

why.text: Petronas is wholly owned by the Malaysian state. Malaysia uses broad laws against its critics and holds refugees and migrants in indefinite detention, and UN experts and the US government report widespread exploitation of migrant workers, including debt bondage. A famous team makes the country look good to millions of fans while that goes on. That’s called sportswashing.
why.messageLine: Human Rights Watch documents migrant workers in forced labour and refugees held in indefinite detention in Malaysia.

name: PGPIC
note: Esteghlal FC's current main shirt sponsor and majority shareholder. TSE-listed holding (symbol فارس); Iran's largest petrochemical group, sanctioned by the US Treasury in June 2019. Rating note: the pull request for this research proposes Serious. The link: the Oil Industry Pension Fund group — self-described as a Petroleum Ministry subsidiary (ANA, 2024-08-14) — is PGPIC's largest shareholder with 38% (Asr-e Iran, 2026-09-05; EcoIran gave 30% for its affiliates in March 2024) and took three of the five board seats at the September 2026 AGM (Petrochemiha and EnergyPress, 2026-09-16). 38% plus a board majority reads as control; maintainers may prefer Concern if they read it as short of control. The record: iran-ffmi-crimes-against-humanity-record and iran-executions-2025-record. It sits under the Petroleum Ministry (chairman's statement, ANA 2024-08-14; the minister chairs the fund's trustees and appoints its board — Asr-e Naft 2026-07-18 and EnergyPress 2024-09-09).

name: Philip Morris International

Left unrated for a maintainer, like zyn: the owner is sourced (pmi-shareholders: NYSE-listed; the holders above 5% are Vanguard, Capital World Investors, Capital International Investors and BlackRock), but the company test isn't settled. Human Rights Watch's report 'Hellish Work' (2010-07-14, https://www.hrw.org/report/2010/07/14/hellish-work/exploitation-migrant-tobacco-workers-kazakhstan) documented, from research in 2009, the exploitation of migrant workers, including child labour, on Kazakh farms that supplied tobacco to Philip Morris Kazakhstan, a PMI subsidiary. Its later reports on hazardous child labour in tobacco farming name PMI among the buyers: in the United States ('Tobacco's Hidden Children', 2014-05-14, https://www.hrw.org/report/2014/05/14/tobaccos-hidden-children/hazardous-child-labor-united-states-tobacco-farming) and in Indonesia through its subsidiary Sampoerna ('The Harvest is in My Blood', 2016-05-25, https://www.hrw.org/report/2016/05/25/harvest-my-blood/hazardous-child-labor-tobacco-farming-indonesia). In the Zimbabwe report (2018) PMI told Human Rights Watch it doesn't buy tobacco there. No record claim is written yet.

Rating note: concern (maintainer decision, 1 Oct 2026, #919; METHOD.md: a joint venture with a military's conglomerate that a UN body documents counts). POSCO is a 100% subsidiary of POSCO Holdings; South Korea's National Pension Service holds 8.30% of POSCO Holdings (posco-holdings-shareholders), which isn't a link (METHOD.md). Also found in review, not used for the rating: Amnesty International's 5 July 2013 press release on forced evictions and a police baton charge over land for the POSCO-India steel project in Odisha (https://www.amnesty.org/en/latest/press-release/2013/07/india-victims-forced-evictions-odisha-must-receive-effective-remedy-and-rep/).

why.text: A UN fact-finding mission on Myanmar named two joint ventures that POSCO companies hold 70% of with MEHL, the Myanmar military's business conglomerate, and found that foreign partners in such ventures at a minimum help fund the military. Amnesty International also named POSCO among MEHL's partners. POSCO's affiliate POSCO C&C said in 2021 it would end its venture with MEHL.
why.messageLine: A UN fact-finding mission named POSCO's joint ventures with the Myanmar military's conglomerate, MEHL, among business ties that help fund the military.

why.text: Qatar Airways is wholly owned by the Government of Qatar. In the years before the 2022 World Cup, migrant workers in Qatar faced widespread abuses, including unpaid wages, recruitment fees and deaths, and Amnesty International and Human Rights Watch report that workers still faced exploitation under the kafala system in 2025. A famous shirt makes the country look good to millions of fans while that goes on. That’s called sportswashing.
why.messageLine: Amnesty International reports that migrant workers in Qatar are still exposed to exploitation.

verdict: Czech carmaker wholly owned (via Volkswagen Finance Luxemburg S.A.) by Volkswagen AG, in which Qatar Holding LLC — a wholly-owned subsidiary of Qatar Investment Authority, the State of Qatar's sovereign wealth fund — holds 10.4% of the subscribed capital and 17.0% of the voting rights.

why.text: Škoda Auto is wholly owned by Volkswagen AG, and Qatar Holding LLC — the investment arm of Qatar's sovereign wealth fund, the Qatar Investment Authority — holds 10.4% of Volkswagen's subscribed capital and 17.0% of its voting rights, making it the third-largest shareholder. So the Qatari state's money is behind Škoda. Amnesty International and Human Rights Watch both report that migrant workers in Qatar continued to face labour abuses under the kafala sponsorship system in 2025 despite reforms.
why.messageLine: Amnesty International reports that migrant workers in Qatar continued to face labour abuses, including an exploitative kafala sponsorship system, despite recent legal reforms.

note: Rating note: concern. The link: Škoda Auto's sole shareholder is Volkswagen Finance Luxemburg S.A. (skoda-auto.com), and Volkswagen AG's Annual Report 2025 names Škoda Auto a.s. among the companies in which it 'holds direct or indirect interests' (claim skoda-vw-ownership); the same report shows Qatar Holding LLC with 10.4% of subscribed capital and 17.0% of voting rights, the third-largest shareholder (claim qatar-holding-vw-stake); two SEC filings by different issuers establish Qatar Holding LLC as a wholly-owned subsidiary of the Qatar Investment Authority (claim qatar-holding-qia-ownership); QIA's own About page names it the sovereign wealth fund of the State of Qatar (claim qia-government-of-qatar-ownership). The record: Amnesty International's Qatar 2025 country entry and HRW's World Report 2026 Qatar chapter, two independent publishers, on continuing migrant-labour abuses under kafala (existing claim qatar-migrant-worker-abuse-2025). Judgement call: Qatar's stake sits in Volkswagen AG two levels above Škoda and is 10.4% — a genuine link, but not control — so 'concern' rather than 'serious' seems right; a maintainer should decide. Rated concern on 2026-10-01 (maintainer decision): Qatar's stake in Volkswagen AG is a link without control.

ACC is a New Zealand Crown entity; New Zealand has no record of serious abuses in the dataset, and state ownership alone is not a tier (METHOD.md). No other state or state fund is among the substantial holders. Company test: SkyCity's regulator actions are anti-money-laundering cases (Federal Court of Australia, A$67m, June 2024; High Court of New Zealand, NZ$4.16m, 2024) and gambling-licence cases about harm minimisation (a five-day closure of the Auckland casino agreed with the Department of Internal Affairs in July 2024; an A$21m fine agreed with South Australia's Liquor and Gambling Commissioner in June 2026, which also covers anti-money-laundering failures). why.text: Turkey’s sovereign wealth fund owns 49.12% of Turkish Airlines, and a special share held by the state carries privileged voting rights over who is nominated to the board. Turkey has kept civil society leader Osman Kavala in prison since 2017, and in 2026 the European Court of Human Rights ruled that he was convicted to punish and silence him. A famous shirt makes the country look good to millions of fans while that goes on. That’s called sportswashing.

why.text: Visit Qatar was set up by Qatar Tourism, the Qatari state’s tourism body, to market the country. Amnesty International and Human Rights Watch report that migrant workers in Qatar still face labour abuses and exploitation under the kafala sponsorship system, despite reforms. A tourism brand on a famous team makes the country look good to millions of fans while that goes on. That’s called sportswashing.
why.messageLine: Amnesty International and Human Rights Watch report that migrant workers in Qatar still face labour abuses under the kafala sponsorship system.

why.text: Visit Rwanda is the tourism brand of the Rwanda Development Board, a Rwandan government institution. UN experts say 3,000–4,000 Rwandan troops are fighting alongside M23 rebels in eastern Congo, and estimated that the rebels made about $800,000 a month from the coltan trade there. A famous shirt makes the country look good to millions of fans while that goes on. That’s called sportswashing.
why.messageLine: UN experts say 3,000–4,000 Rwandan troops are fighting alongside M23 rebels in eastern Congo.

why.text: Visit Saudi is the flagship platform of the Saudi Tourism Authority, a Saudi government body. A tourism brand in a famous stadium makes the country look good to millions of fans while that goes on. That’s called sportswashing.

Rated concern on 2026-10-01 (maintainer decision): Qatar’s stake in Volkswagen AG is a link without control.

why.text: Qatar Holding LLC, a wholly owned subsidiary of the Qatar Investment Authority, the State of Qatar’s sovereign wealth fund, holds 10.4% of Volkswagen AG’s subscribed capital and 17.0% of its voting rights; it was Volkswagen’s third-largest shareholder at the end of 2025. Amnesty International and Human Rights Watch report that migrant workers in Qatar still faced labour abuses and exploitation under the kafala sponsorship system in 2025, despite reforms.

aliases: 成都蓉酒酒业有限公司

why.text: Wanshi Zhenshui is the core brand of Chengdu Rongjiu Liquor, whose five state-owned shareholders are led by Chengdu Industrial Investment Group with a controlling 51%, and whose actual controller is the Chengdu municipal state-assets commission. The UN human rights office found in 2022 that serious human rights violations had been committed against Uyghurs and other mostly Muslim communities in Xinjiang, including large-scale arbitrary detention that may amount to crimes against humanity. So the money behind Wanshi Zhenshui is the Chinese state's.
why.messageLine: The UN human rights office found that China's large-scale arbitrary detention of Uyghurs in Xinjiang may amount to crimes against humanity.

note: Rating note: proposed 'serious' — the Chinese state controls the sponsor (the link, claims chengdu-rongjiu-industrial-group-ownership + chengdu-rongjiu-sasac-actual-controller: a controlling 51% state stake and the Chengdu Municipal SASAC as actual controller; METHOD.md counts control), and the record (claim china-xinjiang-un-assessment) is documented for that state. ON HOLD: awaits a maintainer's review (tier set by maintainers). Shirt placement: the club's 18 May 2026 announcement says the brand will appear on the first-team shirt chest; a 28 June 2026 press report with match photos found the chest advertisement unchanged (成都蓉城/成都建工) through 27 June (Q队长: 咦，成都蓉城的胸前广告还是老样子, Tencent News, 2026-06-28, https://view.inews.qq.com/a/20260628A08RGZ00), so whether and when the brand reached the shirt is not yet documented.

Missing: the shareholding of the business behind X1 (the joint venture, or Shanghai Xiwang Beverage): whether China Sports Industry Group holds a stake, how much, and whether it has a board seat.
